C9000301.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 301 (Trace cones and Razak–Jacelon stabilization.; papers: The trace cone classifies Razak–Jacelon stabilizations; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/301.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_TC_FINITE.statement: The prescribed trace moments and lower coordinates belong to the closed convex hull of whole-cap-controlled genuine candidates.

C_TC_CAP.statement: Controlled evaluations are finite continuous affine on compact caps, and one barycenter reduces each measure part for all candidates simultaneously.

C_TC_REALIZATION.statement: Witness-coded measurable factor realizations attain the selected finite moments and exact lower coordinates without interchanging F and direct integration.

C_TC_SECTOR.statement: Quotient-first approximation inside fixed hereditary supports simultaneously approximates every selected separator and gives whole-cap bounds.

C_EXTENDED_SUPPORT.statement: Finite sector rank sums obey the natural-number budget bound in ENNReal, including zero and infinite controller ranks.

C_TC_AVERAGE.statement: Normalized rational averaging preserves the lower rank estimate with constant 2 norm(y)^2 / epsilon^2 independent of block counts and internal sizes.

C_ST_IDEALS.statement: The invariant maps transport the ideal lattice and finite and zero ideals, as in st:ideals.

C_TC_DIAGONAL.statement: The local diagonal construction retains multiplicative error control, regularized square moments, and bounded lower-comparison witnesses.

C_ROUGH_MODEL.statement: tc:rough-model gives the rough cone model with local defects, square moments, and lower ideal support.

C_CONE_CORRECTION.statement: Fine-label correction removes local errors while preserving constants and trace controls.

C_CONE_MODEL.statement: cc:cone-existence produces an exact cone model with the full extended trace formula.

C_POINT_CORNER.statement: The suspension and corner passage produces the desired point model and its extended-trace normalization.

C_POINT_MODEL.statement: pt:point-model provides point models for the prescribed invariant map.

C_UNIQUENESS.statement: un:uniqueness gives coordinate norm uniqueness from equal model data.

C_INTERTWINING.statement: Coordinate uniqueness and diagonal approximate intertwining give actual algebra isomorphisms realizing the invariant.

C_MAIN_CLASSIFICATION.statement: The full trace cone classifies A tensor W tensor K for arbitrary separable nuclear A.
